stemBlocks: The diagram shows an object of mass $2.4 \text{ kg}$ on a smooth horizontal surface. A force $F$ acts on the object at an acute angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\tan \theta = \frac{4}{3}$. A force of $36 \text{ N}$ acts on the object towards the right. The object is in equilibrium.
What is the magnitude of the normal contact force exerted on the object by the surface? (gravitational field strength = $10 \text{ Nkg}^{-1}$)
